purpose: Follow-up to the initial suppression review: verify the exact PresEx_Suppression class imported by the release Soldier feature, using a fresh hotfix raw capture.

initialEvidence.scope: Release feature/import identity, separate SimEx hotfix capture, one-layer SimEx dependencies, and related release soldier settings.

buildBoundary.limit: The target raw is from Head 4892087. This validates the matching imported class identity, not byte identity or behavior for the Head 4892017 release feature.

targetAsset.xmlStatus: No PresEx_Suppression XML file was present in the searched 1.4.3.0 xml-overlay or xml-changed paths.

confirmed: The exact object class GUID imported by the Head 4892017 Soldier feature matches object 0 of the Head 4892087 PresEx_Suppression raw asset.
The presentation asset has named serialized members Suppression Wedge and Suppression Vignette, both typed DiceVfxHandle, plus AngleEventCounter typed Int.
The presentation asset includes a compiled resource reference; decoding recovered serialized member names and links, not its runtime evaluation.
notEstablished: The release and hotfix assets are from different Heads; their matching file/class GUIDs do not prove the same source bytes were used in both builds.
The VFX labels do not establish when the presentation is activated, what gameplay effect causes it, or how it composes with the separate SimEx_SpotOnSuppression asset.
No suppression amount, spotting range, duration, activation condition, or hit/reset rule is established by this direct target review.
assessment.finalBlocker: Native or compiled expression evaluation and mode-specific activation are not exposed by these EBX fields or the inspected XML.
